caption: The drawing features a square composition with a cream or off-white background lightly shaded with diagonal lines and some feather or leaf motifs in pale tones. At the center, there is a large red flower with multiple rounded petals and five dark green stems radiating outward, each ending in serrated green leaves and small red blossoms. The upper right corner contains two intersecting thick green lines, one vertical and one horizontal, with a small red square at their meeting point and a single red flower fragment in the corner. The left side and bottom edge each show partial symmetrical arrangements featuring a dark green vase shape with stylized green stems, leaves, and three red flowers. The entire composition uses solid patches of color—primarily deep green and rich red—against the lighter background, with clear, distinct outlines on each element.
title: Quilt
